aboutHeroTitle: Handmade with love, made just for you
aboutText:
Blue Aoi began in 2023 with a simple wish: to turn a little box of beads and threads into pieces of joy that people can wear every day. Every bracelet here is designed, strung and finished by hand in Hong Kong — no factories, no mass production, just one pair of careful hands and a lot of love.
Because each piece is made one at a time, tiny variations make every bracelet one of a kind — exactly like the person wearing it. When you wear Blue Aoi, you're wearing something that was made slowly, softly and only for you.

aboutHighlights.title: 100% Handmade
aboutHighlights.text: Every bracelet is designed, strung and finished by hand — never machine-made, never mass-produced.

aboutHighlights.title: One of a Kind
aboutHighlights.text: Small batches and one-of-a-kind pieces, so you won't run into your bracelet on everyone else's wrist.

aboutHighlights.title: Made with Care
aboutHighlights.text: We hand-pick quality beads and threads so your piece stays beautiful wear after wear.

aboutHighlights.title: Personal Service
aboutHighlights.text: Need a different size, colour or gift wrapping? Chat with us on WhatsApp — you'll always talk to a real person.

shippingText:
For the shipping of your item you can choose between SF express and HK Post service.
Depending on your country or zone, some shipping services may not be available.
